data.label: Monitor customer accounts
data.description: Trigger the workflow by continuously monitoring existing customer accounts for churn-risk signals.

data.label: Collect churn signals
data.description: Gather usage trends for the last 30 days, negative-sentiment support tickets, and late or failed invoice payment data for each account.

data.label: Assess usage decline
data.description: Determine whether product usage has dropped over the last 30 days.

data.label: Check support sentiment
data.description: Identify support tickets tagged with negative sentiment for the account.

data.label: Check payment status
data.description: Identify late or failed invoice payments associated with the account.

data.label: Score churn risk
data.description: Combine the churn signals and assign each account a churn-risk score from 0 to 100.

data.label: Route by risk score
data.description: Branch the workflow based on whether the score is above 75, between 40 and 75, or below 40.

data.label: Notify CSM
data.description: Immediately notify the assigned Customer Success Manager for high-risk accounts.

data.label: Draft retention email
data.description: Create a personalized retention outreach email for the high-risk account.

data.label: Queue CSM review
data.description: Add medium-risk accounts to a weekly Customer Success Manager review queue.

data.label: Continue passive monitoring
data.description: Keep low-risk accounts under passive monitoring without additional intervention.

data.label: Log scoring decision
data.description: Record each account's churn-risk score and the input signals used for audit purposes.

message: The workflow continuously monitors customer accounts, gathers churn signals in parallel, scores risk, branches into high/medium/low-risk handling, and logs each decision for audit.

workflow.workflowBrief: Monitor existing customer accounts for churn-risk signals: drop in product usage over the last 30 days, support tickets tagged negative-sentiment, and late or failed invoice payments. Score each account's churn risk from 0 to 100. For scores above 75, immediately notify the assigned Customer Success Manager and draft a personalized retention outreach email. For scores between 40 and 75, add the account to a weekly CSM review queue. For scores below 40, continue passive monitoring. Log every scoring decision with the input signals for audit.
